title: Emerald Blade
description: This mod adds an Emerald Blade which is better than a diamond sword but not as good as netherite sword.
body:
This mod ads a new sword called Emerald Blade
This sword is slightly better than a diamond sword but not as good as a netherite

## Stats
📕Enchantablity: 17
⚔️Attack Damage: 7.5
🚀Attack Speed: 1.7
🔨Number of Uses / Durability: 1750
🔥This item isn't inmune to fire
🟢This item can be repaired with emeralds

## Receipe
This item can be crafted with a stick, 2 emeralds and 2 diamonds
